llm_response.reason: The website demonstrates all characteristics of a legitimate, longstanding online pet supply and veterinary e-commerce store. The domain is nearly 20 years old, with registration and admin details matching the business name and a French address. Discounts and offers are within normal ranges (no unrealistic claims or urgency), and the site provides full legal/contact information, named veterinarians, and proper customer service contacts. References to legitimate payment solutions, ongoing product updates, and professional site organization further confirm its legitimacy. None of the core scam warning signs are present.
